description: Original bilingual reference script for local speech verification. The reference text is freely reusable. Generated audio stays in .data and is not committed.

parts.text: 大家好，欢迎参加今天的项目会议。我们正在测试音视频转文字功能，确认中文识别、说话人区分和时间戳能够正常工作。
Thank you. Today we are testing audio transcription, speaker labels, and timestamps. The edited transcript should export correctly in all five formats.
